ruleDefinitions.name: T1489 — fail2ban/ClamAV Killed Before Brute Force (Fact #41)
ruleDefinitions.description: fail2ban/ClamAV Killed Before Brute Force. Trigger: Repeated SSH authentication failures for root from the same source IP immediately after security daemons are stopped
ruleDefinitions.detectionReason: Repeated SSH authentication failures for root on {host} from {src_ip}
ruleDefinitions.suppressScope: JoinIfExists(EntityId('type: User && direction: Source'), EntityId('type: Device && direction: Source'))
